title: webapp.service looks fine, but nothing answers on its documented port
description_md:
`webapp.service` is active according to systemd, and every runbook says it listens on port 8080 -- but `curl http://localhost:8080/` times out. Nobody touched the unit file itself. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), find out what's actually overriding its configuration, and get it back on the documented port.

You're done when `curl http://localhost:8080/` succeeds.
